name: Oshiete! Yuiko Sensei [Ecchi] o Oboeru Otona no Seikyouiku Lesson!!
original_name: おしえて！唯子先生 【エッチ】を覚える大人の性教育レッスン!!
source:
Main character successfully graduated as sex expert, but lost memory in a traffic accident. Yuiko who comes to tutor is shocked that all sex lessons are needed to start again. But childhood friend and neighbor Eiko is not happy about these relations. How will sex education end?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公成功成为性爱专家，却在交通事故中失去记忆。前来教授的寺川唯子发现，所有性教育课程都得从头开始。但青梅竹马兼邻居河井瑛子对这些关系并不高兴。性教育将如何收场？
